title: Incredible Family Experience
text: Of all the tour experiences we have ever done as a family, this one will stand out. Being picked up and led by David was like having a friend show you around which made it so different from more traditional tours. And then being welcomed into the home of Lucia and Antonio was like being welcomed as family. We enjoyed amazing homecooked food of wonderfully fresh ingredients and my children were treated as they would be by grandparents. Lucia is the abuela everyone needs - radiating love and welcome. author: jamiesS9263RU

title: Best experience ever
text: We had the greatest day with Antonio, Lucia, and David. We felt so welcomed into their home and had a wonderful time experiencing a day in the life with them. The food was delicious and we had so much fun making it.
author: Rachel_L

title: Andalusian Cooking Experience
text: This cooking experience exceeded our expectations.  Hosted by David, our driver and Lucia and Antonio who welcomed us into their home and cooked us a typical Andalusian meal.  This was a wonderful experience and we would highly recommend.  We were made to feel very welcome in their home.
author: mjcheesman

title: Unique Opportunity
text: This is a unique and special opportunity to see behind the doors of a local family's home. They were wonderful, funny, generous. Everyone participated in the cooking- and the eating and drinking! It was done and prepared with love and care.
author: mundomama

title: Local culture at its best
text: David, our guide, picked us up promptly at 11 and the day began. We went to the market in Triana and also did a small walking tour. We shopped with him for the lunch groceries and he was able to give us a lot of history of the area. We had been there the day before by ourselves and this was so much better. Then we went to a wonderful couple's home and were welcomed warmly. Even with the language barrier, we enjoyed visiting and cooking. We even got to visit the bakery across the street and had a behind the scenes tour. We would highly recommend!
author: staugustinekel

title: Great day seeing the true seville
text: David picked us up at 11:00 and the day began. Shopping in Triana at the market for our lunch and a short walking tour. We had visited ourselves the day before and didn’t really understand the history of the area. Then we went to the home of a great couple and we were welcomed  in as part of the family. Even with a language barrier  we were able to understand and David translated as needed. We cooked with the couple and even went across the street to see the local bakery. Gazpacho and pork cheeks and frites with wine and beer. Definitely an experience we won’t forget.
author: kelly5982

title: Cooking Class
text: This was one of my favorite activities on our trip to Spain.  Our cooking class started with a trip to the fresh market.  After gathering the items needed, we continued on to the lovely couples home where the cooking class took place.  We truly loved the experience of making gazpacho,and stew with fresh bread.  Which came from the bakery across the street.
author: KJT518
